name: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate

entry.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate
entry.note: The AWS machine learning credential still on offer after the Machine Learning Specialty was retired in March 2026
entry.audience: ML engineers and MLOps practitioners building on AWS

covers: Generative AI implementation with Amazon Bedrock and RAG architectures
Foundation models and LLMs selection, fine-tuning, and operationalization
Responsible AI practices across traditional ML and generative AI
reading.format: Pearson VUE testing center or online proctored exam. The page lists 85 questions and 65 questions, both multiple choice and multiple response. Languages offered include English (available through September 28, 2026), Japanese, Korean, and Simplified Chinese; additional languages will be available at general availability.
reading.status: The current exam version (MLA-C01) in English is available through September 28, 2026. The current exam in Korean, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese remains available until general availability of MLA-C02. Registration for the updated version (MLA-C02) opens September 1, 2026.
reading.summary: This certification validates technical ability to implement and operationalize machine learning workloads in production. It is intended to help individuals position themselves for in-demand machine learning job roles and boost career credibility.
reading.audience: It is aimed at people with at least one year of experience using Amazon SageMaker AI, Amazon Bedrock, and other ML engineering AWS services, or using Amazon SageMaker and other ML engineering AWS services. The page names roles such as ML engineer, MLOps engineer, LLMOps engineer, data engineer, backend software developer, and data scientist.
reading.prerequisites: The page lists at least one year of experience using Amazon SageMaker AI, Amazon Bedrock, and other ML engineering AWS services, or using Amazon SageMaker and other ML engineering AWS services.
